newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat-Netanyahu to meet Tuesday -PLO official.
newsitem.headline: Arafat-Netanyahu to meet Tuesday -PLO official.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat are likely to meet later on Tuesday when negotiators could initial a self-rule deal for Hebron, a Palestinian negotiator said.

Major-General Abdel-Razak al-Yahya, head of the Palestinian security committee, told Reuters the meeting was expected to take place around 1600 GMT at Erez at the Israeli border with the self-ruled Gaza Strip.
"Initially it has been agreed that a Netanyahu-Arafat summit will take place today. There is a possibility the agreement will be initialled today," Yahya said.
"There is nothing left. Almost everything has been resolved. We are only now finalising the drafting," he said.
Under the deal, Israel will give Palestinians self-rule in 80 percent of the West Bank town, where 400 Jews live in enclaves surrounded by 100,000 Arabs.
